title: One command, nine small changes · symnav stack

headings.text: Follow the command. Stop where it clicks.
Give command syntax to the host.
Publish a view. Keep its toolchain behind it.
Keep the workspace. Empty the query answers.
Carry one policy. Stop at the first guard.
Give each socket job one owner.
Accept once. Run one turn at a time.
Finish the work. Then finish delivery.
Make the new owner the only owner.
